title: BetterAchievements
description: Advanced progression-based achievement system for Paper servers.
body:
# BetterAchievements

The ultimate progression-based achievement plugin for Paper servers.

BetterAchievements transforms achievements from a simple checklist into a complete progression system. Players advance through a carefully designed achievement path, unlock rewards, earn money, receive crate keys, and progress from beginner to endgame.

Designed for Skyblock, Survival, SMP, Lifesteal, and custom gamemodes.

---

## Features

⭐ 100+ configurable achievements

⭐ Progression-based achievement path

⭐ Achievement chains

⭐ Money rewards (Vault)

⭐ Item rewards

⭐ Crate key rewards

⭐ Command rewards

⭐ Live actionbar progress tracking

⭐ Modern GUI

⭐ Multi-page progression menu

⭐ Hidden future achievements

⭐ Multi-language support

⭐ Full PlaceholderAPI support

⭐ Hot reload support

⭐ Highly optimized

⭐ Fully configurable

⭐ Paper 1.21.11 support

---

## Progression-Based Achievement System

Unlike traditional achievement plugins, BetterAchievements uses a progression path.

Players must complete achievements in order.

Example progression:

➡ Join the server

➡ Create an island

➡ Break 10 logs

➡ Break 50 logs

➡ Break 100 logs

➡ Mine 100 cobblestone

➡ Mine 500 cobblestone

➡ Kill 25 pigs

➡ Kill 100 pigs

➡ Harvest 100 wheat

➡ Unlock mob farming

➡ Upgrade your island

➡ Reach endgame

This creates long-term goals and keeps players motivated throughout their entire journey.

---

## Beautiful Progression GUI

BetterAchievements features a modern progression GUI inspired by campaign systems and RPG progression trees.

Features:

✔ Zig-zag progression path

✔ Multi-page navigation

✔ Locked achievement previews

✔ Hidden future achievements

✔ Clean design

✔ Fully configurable

No more boring achievement menus.

---

## Live Progress Tracking

Players can track their progress in real-time through the actionbar.

Examples:

🌳 Oak Logs: 47/100

⛏ Cobblestone: 312/500

🐷 Pigs: 86/100

🌾 Wheat: 421/500

Progress updates instantly while playing.

---

## Reward System

Reward players for progressing through your server.

Supported rewards:

💰 Money rewards (Vault)

💎 Item rewards

🔑 Crate key rewards

📦 Custom command rewards

⚡ Multiple rewards per achievement

Everything can be customized.

---

## Multi-Language Support

BetterAchievements supports multiple languages.

Included:

🇺🇸 English (Default)

🇳🇱 Dutch

All text is stored inside language files.

This includes:

* Achievement names
* Achievement descriptions
* GUI text
* Messages
* Notifications
* Actionbars
* Commands

Create your own translations easily.

---

## Fully Configurable

Every aspect of the plugin can be modified.

Configuration files:

* config.yml
* achievements.yml
* rewards.yml
* gui.yml
* categories.yml
* lang/en_US.yml
* lang/nl_NL.yml

Create your own achievement paths, rewards, messages and GUI layouts.

---

## Performance

Built with performance in mind.

✔ Async processing where possible

✔ Cached player data

✔ Optimized achievement tracking

✔ Low memory usage

✔ Suitable for large servers

✔ Supports hundreds of achievements

✔ Supports hundreds of players

---

## Supported Achievement Types

* First Join
* Island Creation
* Block Breaking
* Mining
* Tree Chopping
* Farming
* Mob Killing
* Fishing
* Crafting
* Smelting
* Economy
* Island Progression
* Spawner Progression
* Crates
* Rare Items
* Endgame Milestones

And much more.

---

## Commands

/achievements

Open the achievements menu.

---

/achievements reload

Reload all plugin files without restarting the server.

---

## Compatibility

Supported Versions:

✔ Paper 1.21.11+

Recommended:

✔ Paper 1.21.11

Optional Dependencies:

* Vault
* PlaceholderAPI

---

## Perfect For

✅ Skyblock

✅ Survival

✅ SMP

✅ Lifesteal

✅ Economy Servers

✅ RPG Servers

✅ Custom Gamemodes

---

Turn grinding into progression.

Turn progression into rewards.

Welcome to BetterAchievements.
